decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to the London Division of the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission, quoting reference date _________.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenceddetails of weatherproofing the proposed structure at the junction with the retained boundary wall shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenceddetails of the proposed restoration of the original building when the screen wall is removed shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development is brought into use.
description: Erection of a two storey office building to rear of existing offices with associated landscaping and boundary treatment (Listed Building Application)
